notes: The fight camera (drawing only; the rules never read this). groundLine: where the floor sits, as a share of the screen height from the top, at every zoom. zoom.near: how much the picture is enlarged while the players are close (1 = the whole 960 px wide view); zoom.far: at full distance. The camera stays at 'near' until the players are nearGap px apart, then widens steadily to 'far' at farGap px. sideMargin: px of room kept outside each player's centre line, whatever the numbers above say. zoom.ease: the share of the remaining change made each frame (smaller = slower, 1 = snaps). jump.headroom: px of room kept above the feet of the highest fighter; jump.topMargin: screen px kept clear at the top (the health bars); jump.zoomOut: a fighter high in the air widens the view before the camera lifts, so the one on the ground stays in the picture; jump.ease: how fast the camera rises and settles. wallMargin: px of view past the stage walls. render.native: draw at the real screen resolution instead of 960x540 stretched; render.maxScale caps it (2 = 1080p, 4 = 4K).
